titulo: Middle East live: Israel conveys 'concerns' to US on Gaza plan
cuerpo: Israel has conveyed concerns to the United States on a Gaza plan hailed by President Donald Trump after Hamas said it had agreed on disarmament, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's office said Monday. Israel's official reaction comes after it killed at least 18 Palestinians over the weekend in the Gaza Strip, including two couples and children, according to local medics. Follow our liveblog for all the latest.
